title: Quantile-Only Regression: Inference and Partial Identification under Quantile Disclosure
abstract: arXiv:2610.27224v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Researchers often observe group quantiles but not group means, raising the question of whether these summaries alone support conventional regression analysis. We develop estimation and inference methods for linear models of group means under quantile-only and mixed disclosure. We establish conditions on disclosure design for consistent estimation and asymptotic normality at the parametric rate. Under fixed disclosure, we characterize sharp identified sets and construct simultaneous confidence regions, clarifying how informativeness depends on the number and placement of disclosed quantiles. Applications to education, social care, and medical expenditure illustrate the methods. The R package qonlyreg implements the proposed procedures.

translated_title: 仅分位数回归：分位数披露下的推断与部分识别
translated_abstract: 研究人员通常只能观测到群体分位数而非群体均值，这就引出了一个关于仅凭这些汇总统计量能否支持常规回归分析的问题。本文针对纯分位数披露和混合披露情形，为群体均值的线性模型开发了估计与推断方法。我们建立了关于披露设计的条件，以保证估计的一致性以及达到参数速率的渐近正态性。在固定披露情形下，我们刻画了锐识别集并构建了同时置信区域，阐明了信息量如何取决于所披露分位数的数量与位置。本文在教育、社会照护和医疗支出方面的应用展示了这些方法。R软件包qonlyreg实现了所提出的方法。
tldr: 本文提出了在仅披露分位数情形下对群体均值线性模型进行估计与推断的方法，给出了一致估计与渐近正态性所需的披露设计条件，在固定披露下刻画了锐识别集，并提供了R软件包qonlyreg实现。
en_tdlr: This paper develops estimation and inference methods for linear models of group means under quantile-only disclosure, establishes conditions on disclosure design for consistent estimation and asymptotic normality, characterizes sharp identified sets under fixed disclosure, and provides the R package qonlyreg.
